title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description_html:
Deskripsi Pekerjaan:

Sales Online bertanggung jawab dalam mencari, menghubungi, dan mengelola calon klien (B2B) melalui berbagai channel digital hingga menghasilkan peluang penjualan. Posisi ini berfokus pada aktivitas prospecting, komunikasi, dan follow-up secara konsisten untuk mencapai target yang telah ditetapkan.

Dalam pelaksanaannya, Sales Online akan memperkenalkan perusahaan dan produk melalui email, WhatsApp, serta media sosial, kemudian menindaklanjuti prospek hingga siap dilakukan meeting. Koordinasi dengan Marketing Manager dan tim sales lapangan menjadi bagian penting untuk memastikan proses penjualan berjalan efektif.

Selain itu, Sales Online tetap bertanggung jawab melakukan follow-up terhadap prospek meskipun telah dialihkan ke tim sales lapangan. Dalam kondisi tertentu, posisi ini juga dapat melakukan kunjungan langsung ke klien, terutama jika diperlukan untuk mempercepat proses closing, dengan pendampingan pada tahap awal.

Peran ini menuntut kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, ketekunan dalam follow-up, serta orientasi kuat terhadap target dan hasil penjualan.
qualifications_html:
Pengalaman:

Minimal 1 tahun pengalaman di bidang sales/marketing, khususnya B2B

Berpengalaman dalam melakukan prospecting, cold calling, dan follow-up klien

Terbiasa menangani pesanan custom menjadi nilai tambah

Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan WhatsApp, email, dan media sosial untuk aktivitas penjualan

Terbiasa bekerja dengan target dan sistem pelaporan penjualan

Kualifikasi Minimum:

Usia 25–45 tahun

Pendidikan minimal D3 dari semua jurusan

Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan negosiasi yang baik

Jujur, disiplin, dan bertanggung jawab

Proaktif dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim

Memiliki laptop pribadi dan kendaraan operasional

Siap melakukan kunjungan lapangan jika dibutuhkan

company.name: CV KENCANA PRINT
company.description:
CV. KENCANA PRINT adalah perusahaan yang berdiri pada tahun 2008 yang pusatnya berada di Boyolali, Jawa Tengah dengan memiliki 3 plant perusahaan dan perusahaan ini bergerak dalam bidang manufaktur garment dan usaha printing, pembuatan spanduk, umbul umbul, vertical banner, layar toko baik berbahan dasar  kain  atau  vinyl, dan promosi outdoor. 

CV. KENCANA PRINT memiliki retail fashion dengan brand "KAOSAN" yang sudah tersebar di beberapa wilayah seperti Boyolali, Sragen, Sukoharjo, Malang, Surabaya, Gresik, Jember, Bekasi dan "REZSO" yang berada di Surabaya dimana produk yang dijual merupakan hasil produksi sendiri.

CV. KENCANA PRINT hadir sebagai solusi lengkap untuk semua kebutuhan spanduk, umbul-umbul, digital printing, dan layanan konveksi bagi perusahaan, instansi pemerintahan, komunitas, hingga pelaku UMKM. Dengan pengalaman lebih dari 14 tahun, kami terus berkembang sebagai mitra yang handal, cepat, dan terpercaya dalam menyediakan produk visual branding dan pakaian kerja berkualitas tinggi.

Kami percaya bahwa setiap pesanan adalah representasi identitas dan profesionalitas klien. Karena itu, CV. Kencana Print selalu berfokus pada kualitas terbaik melalui:
- Mesin modern berteknologi tinggi
- SDM ahli dan berpengalaman
- Chemical pewarna premium yang tahan air, anti luntur, dan tahan sinar matahari
- Standar kontrol kualitas ketat di setiap tahap produksi
- Dengan kapasitas produksi 1.000 pcs per hari untuk Spanduk & Umbul-Umbul dan 2.000 pcs per hari untuk Spanduk Digital Printing, kami mampu memenuhi permintaan dalam jumlah besar tanpa mengurangi kualitas hasil akhir.

Tidak hanya unggul dalam produk cetak, CV. Kencana Print juga menyediakan layanan konveksi profesional untuk berbagai kebutuhan:
- Seragam kerja perusahaan (office, lapangan, pabrik)
- Kaos event, kaos promosi, kaos komunitas
- Polo shirt bordir / sablon
- Kemeja organisasi dan instansi pemerintahan
- Jaket, rompi, hoodie, dan apparel custom lainnya
Semua diproduksi dengan material pilihan, jahitan rapi, dan proses pengerjaan yang cepat serta presisi. Layanan konveksi kami mampu menangani pesanan dalam jumlah kecil hingga ribuan pcs dengan kualitas yang konsisten.

title: Retail Marketing Manager
description_html:
1. In-Store Branding & Visual Merchandising

  • Develop and maintain strong retail brand presence across branch stores, key accounts, official stores, dealer outlets, and modern trade channels.
  • Ensure store layout, product display, signage, POSM, lighting, and visual merchandising standards are consistently executed.
  • Coordinate store renovation, interior design, contractor management, and retail branding improvements.
  • Monitor customer experience and ensure strong brand visibility at every physical touchpoint.

2. Retail Campaign & Activation

  • Plan and execute offline marketing campaigns including grand openings, product launches, roadshows, exhibitions, atrium activations, and festive promotions.
  • Develop retail event strategies to increase foot traffic, customer engagement, and sales conversion.
  • Manage activation budgets and ensure ROI-driven execution.
  • Collaborate with Brand Marketing and Digital Marketing teams for integrated campaign execution.

3. Channel Support (Dealer / Key Account)

  • Support dealer networks, distributors, key accounts, and strategic retail partners with marketing tools and growth initiatives.
  • Develop channel-specific marketing programs to strengthen sell-out performance.
  • Manage retail partnership branding opportunities and promotional collaboration.
  • Ensure sales channels receive strong support for campaign execution and market expansion.

4. Sales Enablement Training

  • Develop product knowledge programs, retail selling tools, and frontline sales support materials.
  • Conduct sales training for promoters, retail teams, dealers, and key account staff.
  • Improve sales presentation standards and product demonstration effectiveness.
  • Ensure frontline teams understand brand positioning and commercial priorities.

5. Retail Performance Monitoring

  • Monitor store productivity, campaign effectiveness, retail traffic, and conversion performance.
  • Analyze retail sales performance by channel, region, and store type.
  • Provide actionable insights for improving retail operations and market execution.
  • Support management reporting for offline channel performance.
qualifications_html:
• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Management, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in retail marketing, trade marketing, or channel marketing.
  • Minimum 2 years in a managerial or leadership role.
  • Strong experience in dealer, distributor, key account, and retail channel management.
  • Experienced in in-store branding, visual merchandising, retail campaigns, and store activation.
  • Familiar with store renovation, contractor coordination, and retail branding execution.
  • Strong understanding of offline sales performance, customer journey, and retail conversion.
  • Experience in sales training, promoter management, and frontline retail operations.
  • Good analytical, leadership, and cross-functional coordination skills.
  • Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and retail performance reporting systems.

title: Partner Growth & Enablement Executive
description_html:
Your responsibilities include:

  • Drive sales growth through implementing partners, ensuring they meet or exceed assigned revenue targets and KPIs.
  • Build and execute joint business plans with each partner — aligning on goals, sales strategies, and target markets.
  • Regularly review partner pipelines, identify opportunities, and provide guidance to accelerate deal closures.
  • Actively join partners in customer meetings, sales calls, demos, and other activities to support co-selling, product positioning, and negotiation with end clients.”
  • Monitor and report on partner sales performance, forecast accuracy, and activity levels.
  • Collaborate with the Partner Manager and internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Technical) to enable and empower partners for success.
  • Maintain high standards of partner performance — balancing support and accountability.
  • Represent the voice of partners internally, ensuring they have the right tools and resources to grow.
qualifications_html:
Must Have:

  • Min. Bachelor degree or higher
  • Fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia
  • 2-5+ Years of experience in B2B sales, account management, or channel/partner management
  • Strong understanding of business processes (finance, sales, inventory, manufacturing, etc.) and variety of business models (service companies, retail companies)
  • Proven track record in driving revenue and growth through parners or resellers
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Analytical and KPI-driven mindset — comfortable working with numbers, forecasts, and performance dashboards.
  • Proactive and organized, with a high sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Highly proactive, result-oriented, and comfortable owning sales targets.

Nice to Have:

  • Understanding of ERP implementation lifecycles and common partner challenges
  • Ability to lead workshops or training session.
  • Immediate availability

🌟 We're Hiring: Financial Controller 🌟

Behind every high-performing business is a disciplined and forward-thinking finance function. We’re looking for a Financial Controller who can lead financial operations, ensure compliance, and drive strategic decision-making across the organization. If you’re ready to take ownership and elevate our financial performance, this role is for you.

✨ What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Financial Reporting & Closing: Lead month-end and year-end closing processes, ensuring accurate and timely financial statements in compliance with accounting standards.
  • Financial Control & Governance: Establish and maintain strong internal controls, ensuring integrity and reliability of financial data.
  • Cash Flow & Working Capital Management: Monitor cash flow, receivables, and payables to ensure optimal liquidity and financial health.
  • Tax & Compliance Oversight: Oversee tax planning, reporting, and compliance, ensuring alignment with local regulations and minimizing risk.
  • General Ledger & Reconciliation: Ensure accuracy of financial records, supervise reconciliations, and resolve discrepancies efficiently.
  • Management Reporting & Insights: Prepare and present financial reports, analysis, and recommendations to support business decisions.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting: Lead budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis to support business planning and performance tracking.
  • Team Leadership: Manage and develop the Finance, Accounting, and Tax team, driving performance and capability building.
  • Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline financial processes, improve systems, and enhance reporting accuracy.
  • Audit & Stakeholder Management: Liaise with external auditors, tax advisors, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth audit and reporting processes.
  • Ad Hoc Projects: Support strategic initiatives including expansion, licensing, and financial structuring.

🛠️ What We’re Looking For:

  • Strong Financial Control Expertise: Proven experience in financial reporting, closing, and internal controls.
  • Leadership Experience: Ability to manage and mentor teams while driving accountability and results.
  • Tax & Regulatory Knowledge: Solid understanding of corporate tax and compliance requirements.
  • Analytical & Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate financial data into actionable business insights.
  • High Attention to Detail: Strong accuracy and problem-solving skills in complex financial environments.
  • Systems & Process Mindset: Experience improving financial processes and working with ERP/accounting systems.

🎉 Why You’ll Love Working Here:

  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal growth and leadership development.
  • High-Performance Culture: Work in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.
  • Stability & Security: A company with consistent growth and no layoffs in the past three years.
  • Collaborative Environment: Partner with passionate and driven teams across the business.

🌍 About Gentem:

At Gentem Lifelong Learning, we empower individuals through education and open doors to new opportunities. As the parent company of Wall Street English Indonesia, Genstarkids, and Indies, we uphold the values of Family, Integrity, and Excellence, fostering a culture of collaboration and impact. If you’re passionate about growth and making a difference, you’ll fit right in.

💪 Ready to Make an Impact?

Join us as a Financial Controller and play a critical role in shaping the financial future of our business. Apply now and be part of our journey.

description_html:

  • Supervise installation, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities of the Cathodic Protection system.
  • Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with standards, specifications, quality requirements, and project targets.
  • Coordinate with clients, vendors, production, QA/QC, procurement, and site teams regarding project execution.
  • Monitor CP system performance and evaluate measurement results and inspection reports.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Cathodic Protection and at least 2 years as Supervisor / Lead Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of Cathodic Protection systems (ICCP & Sacrificial Anode) for pipelines, tanks, structures, jetties, and underground facilities.
  • Familiar with applicable standards such as NACE / AMPP, ISO, DNV, ASME, and client specifications.
  • Capable of performing design review, CP calculations, troubleshooting, testing, commissioning, and system monitoring.
  • Able to read drawings, datasheets, specifications, and technical documents.
  • Strong leadership, communication, cross-functional coordination, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and related engineering software.
  • Understanding of QHSE implementation and project management in CP projects.
  • Willing to travel for business trips / site visits when required.

EF & INTERNATIONAL COMPANIES

EF Foreign Tutor.

GILL delivers premium, efficacious learning outcomes through exclusive partnerships with world-leading content providers and is heavily technology-enabled under separately branded businesses - Wall Street English, Genstarkids, and INDIES (Independent International Education Solutions).

GILL Group was established with the acquisition of the Wall Street English Indonesia business in 2016 and now has over 5,000 active members learning online and in-center across its 11 locations. Genstarkids was launched in October 2025 with the first studio in Bintaro and the second in Cikarang. INDIES was soft-launched in June 2024.

GILL also provides IELTS test prep courses as well as business english courses (professional skills) to both retail and corporate customers. Our corporate customers include blue-chip multinational companies as well as large local conglomerates.

company.name: PT BCA Finance
company.description:
PT BCA Finance berdiri pada tahun 1981 dengan nama PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing Corporation (CSML). Pada awal berdirinya, pemegang saham Perusahaan adalah PT Bank Central Asia dan Japan Leasing Corporation. Saat itu Perusahaan masih memfokuskan usaha pada pembiayaan komersial, seperti pembiayaan mesin-mesin produksi, alat berat dan transportasi.

Selanjutnya pada tahun 2001 PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing berubah nama menjadi PT Central Sari Finance (CSF), diikuti dengan perubahan kepemilikan saham, dimana PT Bank Central Asia, Tbk (BCA) menjadi pemegang saham mayoritas, serta perubahan fokus usaha menjadi pembiayaan kendaraan bermotor, khususnya roda empat atau lebih. Terakhir, Sesuai dengan Surat Keputusan Menteri Hukum dan Hak Asasi Manusia Republik Indonesia No.C-08091 HT.01.04.TH.2005, maka per tanggal 28 Maret 2005 PT Central Sari Finance telah berubah nama menjadi PT BCA Finance.

Kini BCA Finance sendiri telah berhasil mencatatkan asset kelolaan sebesar 52 T dengan profit 1,6 T. Dengan misinya untuk menjadi perusahaan terkemuka di industri pembiayaan PT BCA Finance senantiasa melakukan perubahan dan pengembangan model bisnis untuk menjawab tantangan dan kebutuhan zaman dimana hal ini sejalan dengan tag line perusahaan yaitu solusi tepat pembiayaan anda. 

Untuk mencapai hal tersebut PT BCA Finance memiliki nila-nilai perusahaan yang senantiasa diterapkan yaitu FOCUS yang terdiri dari:

First Class Teamwork
Orientation to Quality
Customer Focus
Uncompromise Integrity
Striving for Excellence

Melalui FOCUS ini seluruh karyawan diarahkan untuk memiliki budaya kerja yang sama sehingga tercipta sebuah Tim yang solid dalam menjalankan bisnis.

Untuk SDM sendiri selain penanaman budaya perusahaan BCA Finance juga focus pada pengembangan skill dan karir karyawannya oleh karena itu kebutuhan pejabat di BCA Finance 90% diperoleh dari internal.

What is it like working at Kitabisa? 

About us 
Kitabisa stands as Indonesia's foremost digital fundraising and donation platform, serving as a nexus for millions of acts of kindness. Originating as a grassroots movement in 2013, we have continually expanded our reach and forged partnerships with diverse entities including corporations, governmental bodies, NGOs, hospitals, and prominent individuals. Together, we harness collective action to address societal challenges, with millions of #orangbaik contributors amplifying our impact in aiding those in need. Through leveraging technology, our vision is to cultivate the largest community dedicated to mutual aid and support. Our recent milestone, the acquisition of a sharia-compliant life insurance company, underscores our dedication to advancing inclusive and ethical financial solutions, furthering our mission of social impact and innovation.


What we value 
At Kitabisa, our work isn't just about tasks; it's about purpose. We're dedicated to connecting acts of kindness, amplifying their impact, and directly improving the lives of others, infusing our work with profound meaning. Guided by the principles of Berani, Berbuat, Baik, we embody courage by doing what's right even when no one's watching, upholding truthfulness, and respecting diversity. We are committed to action, understanding that mere words hold little weight without tangible steps forward. As 'doers', we prioritize action and value progress over perfection. Kindness forms the bedrock of everything we do, extending to ourselves, our colleagues, and, most importantly, those in need. If you share our values and seek to make a genuine difference in the lives of others, we invite you to join us on this meaningful journey.


Our Commitment

title: Client Resolution Specialist
description_html:
As a Client Resolution Specialist, you will act as the primary bridge between our prestigious clients (Insurance Companies and Hospitals) and our internal departments. Your mission is to ensure every client issue, ranging from technical glitches to complex fraud investigations, is resolved thoroughly and efficiently. You will perform deep-dive investigations to identify root causes and collaborate with internal stakeholders to implement long-term solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Issue Management: Act as the central point of contact for high-level complaints from clients (Insurers & Healthcare Providers).
  • Cross-Functional Investigation: Conduct thorough internal investigations involving various departments (IT, Claims, Medical, Legal, and Manpower) to pinpoint the source of operational or technical failures.
  • Problem Solving: Analyze issues related to the healthcare application platform, claim disputes, potential fraud cases, and outsourced manpower performance.
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Identify systemic issues rather than just "fixing the symptoms" to prevent recurring complaints.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Lead meetings with internal department heads to negotiate solutions and ensure corrective actions are taken within the agreed SLA.
  • Reporting: Prepare comprehensive resolution reports for both the client and management, detailing the investigation process, findings, and improvements implemented.
  • Process Improvement: Provide strategic recommendations to management based on complaint trends to enhance overall service quality and client satisfaction.
qualifications_html:
• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Hospital Management, Public Health, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Client Relations, Quality Assurance, Case Management, or Operations, preferably within the Healthcare, TPA, or Insurance industry.
  • Analytical Thinking: Exceptional investigative skills with the ability to connect the dots between technical data and operational processes.
  • Conflict Resolution: Proven experience in handling difficult clients and managing high-pressure situations with a professional and calm demeanor.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia.
  • Technical Literacy: Proficient in understanding how digital platforms/apps work and comfortable analyzing data or workflows.
  • Independence: Ability to work autonomously, take initiative, and "poke" internal teams to get answers when necessary.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description_html:
Role Overview & Responsibilities

As part of our Business Intelligence team, you’ll be at the core of our decision-making engine — transforming raw data into meaningful insights that power strategy, operations, and growth. Whether it's spotting performance trends or optimizing internal processes, your work will have a direct impact across the organization and the industry.

  • Design, build, maintain, and optimize datasets to support business intelligence initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using BI tools like Power BI, Looker Studio (Google Data Studio), Metabase, or Superset.
  • Write efficient SQL queries to extract, clean, and interpret data from various relational databases.
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for business improvement.
  • Write clear and easy-to-understand documentation for your analyses, dashboards, and data logic to improve collaboration across teams.
  • Monitor KPIs and support ongoing performance reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., Commercial, Operations, Product) to understand business needs and deliver actionable insights.
  • Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, and automation opportunities proactively.
  • Ensure accuracy, integrity, and governance best practices in all BI deliverables.
  • Stay current with the latest BI tools, techniques, and industry trends.
qualifications_html:
What We Are Looking For

We’re looking for a natural problem-solver with a passion for turning data into stories — someone who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is eager to make a tangible impact.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Administration, or related fields (or equivalent experience).
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a related role. Alternatively, demonstrated ability to solve data analytics problems in a measurable and impactful way.
  • Proficiency in SQL and working knowledge of relational databases is essential. Familiarity with BigQuery is a plus.

title: Medical Assessment Analyst
description_html:
This role is responsible for conducting comprehensive analysis of Medical Check-Up (MCU) results by integrating claim history data, as well as developing data-driven wellness programs, monitoring employees with identified health risks, and providing consultative insights to clients.

Medical Analysis & Risk Stratification:
1. Analyze prospective client needs to design suitable Medical Check-Up (MCU) packages aligned with workforce risk profiles, industry requirements, and cost considerations
2. Perform comprehensive analysis of MCU results to identify employees’ health risk factors
3. Determine fitness for work status (fit, temporary unfit, or work restriction) based on medical findings
4. Translate medical analysis into clear insights and present findings, including actionable recommendations, to clients (HR/management) in a structured and professional manner

Health Monitoring & Case Management:
1. Monitor employees with high-risk MCU findings
2. Provide medical recommendations for follow-up actions (referral, further evaluation, early intervention)
3. Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to ensure compliance with recommended health actions

Wellness Program Development
1. Develop data-driven wellness programs based on MCU results and claim data
2. Identify priority health interventions based on employee risk profiles
3. Evaluate the effectiveness of wellness programs and provide recommendations for improvement
qualifications_html:
Minimum Qualifications:
1. Medical Doctor (MD) degree
2. Strong interest in preventive medicine, occupational health, or population health
3. Ability to interpret MCU results (laboratory, radiology, ECG, etc.)
4. Ability to perform continuous health monitoring and follow-up for employees with identified health risks based on MCU results
5. Fresh Graduate are welcome

Required Skills:
1. Clinical Judgment & Medical Analysis
2. Analytical Thinking & Data Interpretation
3. Problem Solving
4. Communication & Presentation Skills
5. Case Monitoring & Follow-up Management (ability to track, evaluate, and ensure compliance of high-risk employee cases)

title: Senior UI/UX Designer

Two designers. 20,000+ doctors. Millions of patients.

That's our current ratio of team to impact. If you've worked on teams where your designs disappeared into endless review cycles, this is the opposite.

SeriousMD and NowServing are healthcare products that people actually use daily.

We need a Senior UI/UX Designer who can own product areas end-to-end, from research to shipped pixels.

About Us

Leapfroggr builds SeriousMD (the EMR platform Filipino doctors trust) and NowServing (connecting patients to providers nationwide). Our products handle real medical records, real appointments, real patient care.

How to Apply

Send your portfolio showing your process, not just final screens. Tell us which of our products (SeriousMD or NowServing) you'd want to work on first, and why.

About us 
Kitabisa stands as Indonesia's foremost digital fundraising and donation platform, serving as a nexus for millions of acts of kindness. At Kitabisa, our work isn't just about tasks; it's about purpose. We're dedicated to connecting acts of kindness, amplifying their impact, and directly improving the lives of others, infusing our work with profound meaning. Guided by the principles of Berani, Berbuat, Baik, we embody courage by doing what's right even when no one's watching, upholding truthfulness, and respecting diversity. We are committed to action, understanding that mere words hold little weight without tangible steps forward. As 'doers', we prioritize action and value progress over perfection. Kindness forms the bedrock of everything we do, extending to ourselves, our colleagues, and, most importantly, those in need. If you share our values and seek to make a genuine difference in the lives of others, we invite you to join us on this meaningful journey.


Our Commitment
Kitabisa is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

company.name: Marga Nusantara Jaya
company.description:
PT Marga Nusantara Jaya menjadi distributor resmi PT Konimex sejak 28 September 1985. Sejarah awal terbentuknya PT Marga Nusantara Jaya dimulai pada tanggal 8 Maret 1980, dimana pemerintah mengeluarkan keputusan tentang pemisahan antara badan usaha produksi dengan badan usaha distribusi. Hal tersebut dijawab oleh PT Konimex dengan mendirikan sebuah badan usaha distribusi dengan nama PT Sinar Intermark. 

PT Sinar Intemark bertindak sebagai penyalur utama produk-produk Konimex dengan cakupan seluruh wilayah Indonesia. Senada dengan berkembangnya perusahaan, PT Konimex juga meluaskan bidang usahanya ke bidang industri permen dan makanan dengan nama Nimm’s untuk permen dan Sobisco untuk makanan. 

Seiring berkembangnya wilayah cakupan distribusi, pelanggan, jumlah serta jenis produk, maka Konimex merasa perlu untuk menambah satu lagi perusahaan distribusi. Pada tanggal 28 September 1985, Bapak Djoenaedi Joesoef membeli perusahaan distribusi bernama PT Marga Nusantara Jaya. PT Marga Nusantara Jaya mulai aktif menjalankan usahanya di bawah payung PT Konimex pada tanggal 1 Maret 1986. Pembelian tersebut menjadikan PT Konimex memiliki dua perusahaan distributor yang pembagiannya adalah PT Marga Nusantara Jaya sebagai distributor produk-produk non-farmasi (food and candy) dan PT Sinar Intemark sebagai distributor produk-produk farmasi. 

Tahun 2007 merupakan tahun yang penting bagi Konimex Group, PT Konimex memutuskan untuk melakukan desain-ulang area distribusi dan pembagian jenis produk yang selama ini telah diterapkan terhadap kedua perusahaan distribusinya. PT Sinar Intemark diberi tanggung jawab untuk mendistribusikan seluruh produk, baik food maupun farmasi, di wilayah Indonesia bagian Timur. Sedangkan, PT Marga Nusantara Jaya mendistribusikan semua produk, baik food maupun farmasi, di wilayah Indonesia bagian Barat. 

Tahun 2013, PT Sinar Intemark digantikan perannya oleh PT Marga Nusantara Jaya, dimana PT Sinar Intemark sudah tidak menjadi distributor dari produk PT. Konimex dan seluruh distributor produk dilakukan oleh PT Marga Nusantara Jaya. PT Konimex hingga saat ini memiliki predikat baik di kalangan perusahaan bidang farmasi, makanan, permen dan natural product berskala nasional yang memiliki jaringan 52 cabang di hampir semua kota besar utama di Indonesia dengan dukungan ratusan armada distribusi 

Tahun 2019, seluruh cabang PT Marga Nusantara Jaya telah mendapat sertifikat CDOB, sebagai salah satu syarat resmi untuk bisa menjadi distributor Farmasi. Selain itu, di tahun tersebut, PT Marga Nusantara Jaya menjadi distributor multiprinciple dan mulai mendistribusikan alat kesehatan, selain Farmasi, Natural Product dan Makanan.

description_html:
About this Position

We are looking for a Mass Hiring Recruitment Officer who is responsible for handling high-volume recruitment of blue-collar partners to support operational needs. This role ensures timely fulfillment, coordinates closely with the operations team regarding partner performance and violations, manages related administrative and disciplinary processes, and maintains recruitment quality in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

title: DevOps engineers
description_html:
• Development and maintain the infrastructure: DevOps engineers are responsible for creating and managing the infrastructure needed to support software development and deployment. This includes designing, configuring, and maintaining servers, networks, storage, and other infrastructure components.
  • Automate processes: DevOps engineers use automation tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Chef to automate tasks like software deployment, configuration management, and testing. They also develop and maintain scripts and code to automate processes and tasks.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams: DevOps engineers work closely with development, testing and support team to ensure that software applications are developed and deployed smoothly. They collaborate on code changes, help troubleshoot issues, and ensure that applications are deployed in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Implement and manage security policies: DevOps engineers are responsible for implementing and managing security policies and procedures to ensure the safety and integrity of the software applications and data. This include identifying potential security threats, implementing security measures, and monitoring for security breaches.
  • Continuously improve processes: DevOps engineers are always looking for ways to improve the software development and deployment process. They analyze performance metrics and other data to identify areas for improvement and work to implement changes that increase efficiency and reduce errors.
  • Problem-solving and troubleshooting skills: DevOps engineers should be able to troubleshoot issues quickly and effectively and have experience working with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, Splunk, or Dataog to identify and resolve problems.
qualifications_html:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related fields, or equivalent professional experience
  • Minimum 2 years’ experience with IT operations and infrastructure management and familiar with network and server administration, virtualization, cloud computing, and storage management.
  • Have a strong foundation and familiarity with operating systems like Linux or Windows.
  • Proficient in using automation tools like Ansible, Puppet or Chef, and have experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.

title: Legal Manager
description_html:
About the Role

We are looking for a Legal Manager to lead and strengthen our legal, compliance, and governance functions. This role will play a critical part in ensuring the company operates in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations while supporting business growth through strategic legal guidance.

Key Responsibilities

Compliance

  • Ensure the validity and completeness of all company licenses and permits
  • Initiate and manage regulatory licensing requirements
  • Prepare and submit investment and corporate reports to government authorities

Contract & Document Management

  • Draft, review, and update product Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy
  • Standardize and manage company contracts
  • Review contracts requested by internal stakeholders

Litigation, Fraud & Non-Compliance Handling

  • Manage and oversee litigation, fraud, and compliance-related cases
  • Ensure proper investigation and legal follow-up processes
  • Collaborate with Audit, Anti-Fraud, and other teams to mitigate legal risks
  • Provide strategic updates and recommendations to management

Governance & Company Administration

  • Ensure implementation of corporate governance in line with regulations
  • Oversee legal documentation and compliance reporting
  • Coordinate with notaries, external lawyers, regulators, and government institutions

Legal Strategy

  • Develop and execute legal strategies aligned with business objectives
  • Provide strategic legal advice to management
  • Identify legal risks and ensure regulatory compliance in business decisions

People Management

  • Lead and manage the legal team
  • Allocate tasks and ensure timely project delivery
  • Monitor team performance and support individual development
qualifications_html:
Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Law (S1 Hukum)
  • Minimum 5–6 years of experience in Legal/Compliance or related field
  • Experience in handling contracts, litigation, and corporate compliance

Key Competencies

  • Solid understanding of legal & regulatory landscape, and knows how to apply it in real business situations
  • Confident, clear, and structured in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating contracts end-to-end
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Adaptable to changing priorities and able to handle ambiguity
  • Able to balance compliance with business agility
  • Detail-oriented, with a sharp eye for risks and inconsistencies
  • Sound judgment with a practical, solution-first approach to problem solving
  • Able to communicate and influence stakeholders effectively (not just advise, but drive decisions)
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

title: Senior Lead Risk Management
description_html:
Risk Strategy & Framework

  • Develop and implement enterprise-wide risk management frameworks, policies, and procedures
  • Ensure alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements
  • Continuously enhance risk methodologies, tools, and governance practices

Risk Identification & Assessment

  • Lead risk identification exercises across business units (operational, financial, compliance, strategic risks, and IT system related risks)
  • Conduct risk assessments and prioritize key risk areas
  • Establish risk registers and maintain up-to-date documentation

Risk Mitigation & Monitoring

  • Design and implement risk mitigation plans and controls
  • Monitor effectiveness of controls and recommend improvements
  • Track key risk indicators (KRIs) and provide regular reporting to leadership

Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with senior leadership, business heads, and cross-functional teams to embed risk awareness into decision-making
  • Act as a trusted advisor on risk-related matters
  • Facilitate risk discussions in leadership forums and committees
  • Develop and deliver regular risk reports to senior management and prepare high-level risk updates for investors, Board of Directors, and key stakeholders

Business, Regulatory, and Compliance Oversight

  • Ensure compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and internal policies
  • Liaise with auditors, regulators, and external stakeholders when needed
  • Stay updated on regulatory changes and assess impact to business
  • Mapping all business processes and review and standardization of all SOPs

Crisis & Incident Management

  • Lead risk response during incidents and crises
  • Develop business continuity and risk response plans
  • Conduct post-incident analysis and drive preventive actions

Loss Prevention & Fraud Management

  • Define and execute loss prevention strategy to minimize fraud and operational losses
  • Identify fraud patterns, vulnerabilities, and emerging threats
  • Design preventive and detective controls (rules engine, alerts, monitoring systems)
  • Partner with Product & Tech to embed fraud prevention into systems and user flows
  • Continuously monitor and optimize fraud rate, loss rate, and control efficiency

Risk Analytics & Data-Driven Decisioning

  • Lead the Risk Data Analyst team to build insights, dashboards, and predictive models
  • Translate data into actionable risk strategies and business recommendations
  • Develop and monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), fraud metrics, and portfolio performance
  • Drive automation and data-driven decisioning (e.g., rule optimization, scoring models)
  • Collaborate with Data/Tech teams on data infrastructure and risk tooling

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop the risk management team
  • Build risk awareness culture across the organization through training and communication
qualifications_html:
Experience & Background

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Risk Management, or related field (Master’s is a plus)
  • 8–12+ years of experience in Risk Management, Internal Audit, Compliance, or related roles
  • Proven experience in leading risk frameworks at an organizational level
  • Experience in fintech, financial services, or high-growth tech companies is a strong advantage

Core Competencies

  • Strong understanding of enterprise risk management (ERM) principles
  • Ability to translate complex risks into actionable business insights
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills (especially with senior leaders)
  • High ownership and ability to operate in fast-paced environments
  • Strong executive reporting and data storytelling skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear, concise, and impactful insights that support strategic decision-making

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Strategic thinking with strong execution capability
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively
  • High integrity and strong risk mindset
  • Willingness to be hands-on and visit the fields (e.g. hubs, warehouse) to directly observe operations to gain ground-level insight

Nice to Have

  • Professional certifications related to risk management (e.g., FRM, CRM, CFA, CIA)
  • Experience handling regulatory bodies (e.g., OJK, BI if in Indonesia context)
  • Experience in observing, implementing, or maintaining ISO standards (e.g., ISO 31000, ISO 27001) within risk management frameworks
  • Exposure to digital risk, data/privacy risk, or fraud risk management
  • Experience with automated risk monitoring and AI-driven predictive modeling

title: Commercial Analysis Senior Associate
description_html:
About Astro

ASTRO is Indonesia's quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. Founded in 2021 by a group of seasoned e-commerce executives and is backed trusted international investors, it is our mission to make people's lives simpler and easier by saving them time, energy, and money.

Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced.

Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission!

About this Position

This role drives commercial performance by translating data-driven insights into actionable strategies that support growth, profitability, and business OKRs. You will act as a key commercial driver, monitoring business performance, identifying risks and opportunities, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure effective execution. The role combines hands-on analytics with strategic thinking to guide decisions at both SKU and business-unit levels.

Job Description

  • Formulate and execute impactful commercial strategies to drive growth, profitability, and attain business objectives.
  • Take a proactive lead as the main business driver for commercial business unit, shaping the strategic direction and actively seeking growth opportunities.
  • Monitor and take ownerships of OKRs, key business metrics, and profitability indicators, identify and take decisive actions when OKRs are at risk.
  • Perform market analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and challenges on commercial operations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to drive continuous improvements in both on a regular and project basis.
  • Prepare presentations for performance and management-related reviews, ensuring clear communication of insights and strategic initiatives.
  • Support commercial teams in understanding data points, insights, and analysis, providing necessary training to enhance the team's understanding and application of data-driven strategies.
qualifications_html:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or other quantitative field.
  • Experience: 2–4 years in business analysis, category support, or commercial operations within retail/FMCG/e-commerce/e-groceries/fresh and frozen food
  • Analytics Skills: Solid Excel/Google Sheets.
  • Retail Fluency: Comfortable with core metrics (margin %, velocity, OOS, Impression, CVR) and basic quality-control concepts for fresh & frozen categories.

company.name: PT BCA Finance
company.description:
PT BCA Finance berdiri pada tahun 1981 dengan nama PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing Corporation (CSML). Pada awal berdirinya, pemegang saham Perusahaan adalah PT Bank Central Asia dan Japan Leasing Corporation. Saat itu Perusahaan masih memfokuskan usaha pada pembiayaan komersial, seperti pembiayaan mesin-mesin produksi, alat berat dan transportasi.

Selanjutnya pada tahun 2001 PT Central Sari Metropolitan Leasing berubah nama menjadi PT Central Sari Finance (CSF), diikuti dengan perubahan kepemilikan saham, dimana PT Bank Central Asia, Tbk (BCA) menjadi pemegang saham mayoritas, serta perubahan fokus usaha menjadi pembiayaan kendaraan bermotor, khususnya roda empat atau lebih. Terakhir, Sesuai dengan Surat Keputusan Menteri Hukum dan Hak Asasi Manusia Republik Indonesia No.C-08091 HT.01.04.TH.2005, maka per tanggal 28 Maret 2005 PT Central Sari Finance telah berubah nama menjadi PT BCA Finance.

Kini BCA Finance sendiri telah berhasil mencatatkan asset kelolaan sebesar 52 T dengan profit 1,6 T. Dengan misinya untuk menjadi perusahaan terkemuka di industri pembiayaan PT BCA Finance senantiasa melakukan perubahan dan pengembangan model bisnis untuk menjawab tantangan dan kebutuhan zaman dimana hal ini sejalan dengan tag line perusahaan yaitu solusi tepat pembiayaan anda. 

Untuk mencapai hal tersebut PT BCA Finance memiliki nila-nilai perusahaan yang senantiasa diterapkan yaitu FOCUS yang terdiri dari:

First Class Teamwork
Orientation to Quality
Customer Focus
Uncompromise Integrity
Striving for Excellence

Melalui FOCUS ini seluruh karyawan diarahkan untuk memiliki budaya kerja yang sama sehingga tercipta sebuah Tim yang solid dalam menjalankan bisnis.

Untuk SDM sendiri selain penanaman budaya perusahaan BCA Finance juga focus pada pengembangan skill dan karir karyawannya oleh karena itu kebutuhan pejabat di BCA Finance 90% diperoleh dari internal.

description_html:
Analisis Kebutuhan dan Peluang Layanan Utilitas

  • Mengumpulkan data kebutuhan utilitas tenant untuk berbagai jenis layanan utilitas kawasan.

  • Mengidentifikasi peluang pengembangan layanan utilitas baru atau penguatan layanan yang sudah ada.

  • Menganalisis kesesuaian kebutuhan tenant dengan potensi pengembangan bisnis utilitas kawasan.

Pengembangan Skema Bisnis Utilitas

  • Menyusun konsep awal skema bisnis layanan utilitas berdasarkan kebutuhan tenant dan arah pengembangan kawasan.

  • Mengkaji alternatif model layanan, skema kerja sama, dan potensi monetisasi masing-masing layanan utilitas.

  • Menyiapkan bahan analisis untuk penyempurnaan skema bisnis utilitas kawasan.

Penyusunan Model Bisnis dan Kajian Finansial Awal

  • Mengumpulkan data dasar biaya, asumsi CAPEX, OPEX, dan proyeksi pendapatan layanan utilitas.

  • Menyusun perhitungan awal model bisnis, cost recovery, dan potensi revenue sharing.

  • Menganalisis kelayakan awal model bisnis utilitas untuk bahan evaluasi atasan.

Dukungan Feasibility Study Utilitas

  • Menyiapkan data pasar, kebutuhan tenant, serta asumsi komersial untuk studi kelayakan.

  • Melakukan analisis awal terhadap aspek bisnis, pasar, dan potensi komersial pengembangan utilitas.

  • Menyusun bahan rekomendasi untuk penilaian kelayakan investasi utilitas.

Proyeksi Kebutuhan Utilitas Tenant

  • Mengumpulkan data pemakaian dan kebutuhan utilitas tenant untuk jangka pendek, menengah, dan panjang.

  • Mengolah data proyeksi kebutuhan utilitas sebagai dasar perencanaan komersial.

  • Menyelaraskan hasil proyeksi dengan potensi pertumbuhan tenant dan kawasan.

Monetisasi dan Pengembangan Produk Layanan

  • Mengidentifikasi peluang monetisasi dari layanan utilitas yang tersedia.

  • Menyusun usulan pengembangan produk atau skema layanan untuk meningkatkan penetrasi ke tenant.

  • Memantau perkembangan pipeline peluang bisnis utilitas dan tindak lanjutnya.

Pelaporan dan Dokumentasi Bisnis Utilitas

  • Menyusun laporan hasil analisis peluang bisnis dan kebutuhan tenant.

  • Mendokumentasikan draf model bisnis, proyeksi, dan kajian awal yang telah disusun.

  • Menyampaikan laporan untuk kebutuhan evaluasi dan pengambilan keputusan atasan.

Manajemen dan Mitigasi Risiko

  • Melakukan identifikasi, pengelolaan, pelaporan, kontrol, dan evaluasi mitigasi risiko secara berkala dengan memperhatikan target dan kebijakan risiko sesuai alur proses bisnis dan faktornya, serta memperhatikan aspek risiko dalam setiap keputusan dan ikut dalam program pengembangan budaya risiko.
qualifications_html:
• (S1) di bidang Teknik Industri, Teknik Sipil, Teknik Lingkungan, Manajemen, Ekonomi, atau bidang lain yang relevan.

  • Pengembangan Bisnis Utilitas : Pemahaman dalam penyusunan dan pengembangan skema bisnis layanan utilitas kawasan.

  • Analisis Kelayakan Bisnis : Kemampuan dalam melakukan feasibility study dan analisis aspek teknis, finansial, dan komersial.

  • Financial Modeling : Pemahaman dalam penyusunan model keuangan, termasuk CAPEX, OPEX, cost recovery, dan proyeksi pendapatan.

  • Perencanaan dan Forecasting : Pengetahuan dalam melakukan proyeksi kebutuhan utilitas dan potensi pasar tenant.

  • Analisis Pasar dan Produk : Pemahaman dalam mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis, pengembangan produk layanan, dan peningkatan penetrasi pasar.

  • Manajemen Kontrak dan Komersial : Pengetahuan dasar dalam penyusunan skema kontrak dan struktur layanan utilitas.

  • Koordinasi Stakeholder : Kemampuan dalam berkoordinasi dengan unit internal, tenant, dan mitra bisnis.

title: Strategist
description_html:
At Aleph, we design human-centered digital solutions by combining strategy, technology, and creativity. We work closely with clients, treating their business as our own, to align on goals and drive strategic initiatives through research, data, and insights to solve business challenges.

Currently, we are pushing initiatives across the organization to provide strategic advisory on the following topics:

  • User Experience: Strategize App or Web experiences that best fit and build the user mental model, and ensure its desirability (pleasant to use), viability (meet business objectives), and feasibility (can be executed).
  • Customer Experience: Redesign customer experiences and journey maps, leverage customer behavior data and insights to create transformative digital interfaces.
  • Product Development & Management: Transform ideas into market-fit products that meet both user needs and business objectives, while guiding the entire product lifecycle—from concept to optimization.
  • Growth & Experimentation: Use data-driven strategies and experimentation to expand customer base, increase loyalty, and maximize lifetime value.
  • Performance Evaluation & Optimization: Analyze and forecast product KPIs, deliver actionable recommendations to drive growth, improve user engagement, and optimize overall performance.

As a Strategist, you will play a pivotal role in pushing new initiatives, with responsibilities including:

  • Collaborating with Designers, Researchers, and Engineers to drive strategic initiatives and guide project direction in partnership with Project Leads.
  • Collaborating with clients to understand their context, challenges, and business goals to sharpen our focus scope.
  • Spearheading the team to conduct in-depth research and data analysis to uncover insights and solutions tailored to client challenges.
  • Experimenting with new approaches and discovering best practices for effective problem-solving.
  • Presenting discovered opportunities and solutions to our clients, engaging audiences from the working team to senior leadership.

Your Growth Opportunities
As part of this role, you’ll have the chance to:

  • Drive your own initiative, sharpen your leadership skills, and shape the project team direction, with the guidance of senior Strategists for advisory and consultation.
  • Explore opportunities to provide strategic advisory on various topics, including but not limited to:
    • Digital Transformation & Strategy: Redefine the role of digital in client's business and accelerate their transformation efforts.
    • Business Projection & Analysis: Project business outcomes, identify risks, and engage with senior management to discuss strategic pivots and implications.
    • Market Positioning: Identify market opportunities, refine brand positioning to increase visibility and strengthen competitive advantage.
    • Go-to-Market: Craft strategies to launch products and services to the right audience at the right time, from market positioning, messaging, and distribution channel selection.

ALEPH PROFILE:

Hello, we noticed you taking a peek.

It all started on a stormy day in May 2006. There was rain, there was thunder, there was lightning, and there was Aleph.

Aleph is a striking group of craftsmen specialised in strategy, design and technology. We work together to plan, write and produce internet, mobile, and desktop solutions for the most daring set of clients. Bold clients who see the future of user-centric experience and engage Aleph as their rocket fuel.

ALEPH CULTURE:

We’ve grown from a garage operation to a staff strength of 300 and growing across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam and Thailand; but we still maintain a boutique company feel and culture within each local market. This is what bonds us and yet frees us enough to apply our unique talents, to deliver functional and flexible solutions, to dream big and to make it happen within this part of the world.

First discovered in 2006 the Alephian is a rare species. As a highly collaborative species, the Alephian loves to gather together and exercise great creativity to accomplish large difficult projects for its counter part in the natural hierarchy: “the client”.

The Alephian’s natural habitat is in the mobile and internet space where its nimble fingers and outstanding control of Wacom pens creates beautiful websites, apps, and campaigns.

A peculiar characteristic is the Alephian ability to communicate relevant information consistently. This is highlighted by a Friday morning tradition where they gather around food and exchange knowledge. This appears to be an effort to become a better group of species.

When not at work, Alephians can be found enjoying Southeast Asia’s beautiful resorts and beaches, planning a theme party or cycling together. And if you ever walk by, put your hand up. Alephians love giving high fives.

Lead HSSE will be responsible for building and standardizing the Health, Safety, Security, and Environmental framework across ASTRO warehouse operations, particularly during expansion and renovation projects. This role acts as a subject-matter expert and individual contributor who ensures safety standards are embedded from planning to execution. The position plays a critical role in balancing regulatory compliance, operational productivity, and risk mitigation across multi-site facilities.

Job Description:

  • Develop and standardize HSSE framework & guidebook tailored to warehouse operations (setup, expansion, renovation).
  • Establish safety standards for new site layout, facility planning, and contractor activities.
  • Lead risk identification and assessment (Hazard Identification, Job Safety Analysis) and develop corrective & preventive action plans (CAPA).
  • Translate safety risks into measurable business impact and propose mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure compliance with K3, environmental, and other applicable regulations; maintain up-to-date permits and documentation.
  • Conduct safety inspections, audits, and incident investigations across warehouse sites.
  • Deliver HSSE training and awareness programs for stakeholders.
  • Partner with Operations teams to balance safety standards with productivity needs.
  • Identify HSSE budget requirements and support cost planning for preventive initiatives.
qualifications_html:
• Minimum D3, D4, or S1 in Occupational Health & Safety (K3), Environmental Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
  • Certified AK3U (Kemnaker) is mandatory.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in HSSE, preferably from warehouse, logistics, retail distribution, or manufacturing industries.
  • Proven experience in developing HSSE standards/frameworks and handling expansion or renovation projects.
  • Strong knowledge of Indonesian K3 and environmental regulations and familiar with ISO standards (ISO 45001, ISO 14001, ISO 9001) is preferred.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, and risk-mapping capability.
  • Proficient in MS Office / Google Workspace; able to use visualization tools (e.g., Visio) for safety layout planning.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

company.name: Gentem Indonesia Lifelong Learning Group
company.description:
We believe that the best and most successful people are 'students' of their fields who are find happiness in the constant pursuit of growth, professionally and personally - a lifelong learner. The faster the world around us changes, the more important it is to be a lifelong learner in order to stay competitive.

Lifelong learning comprises four soft skills (Communication, Critical Thinking, Collaboration, Creativity) and four mindset attributes (Curiosity, Initiative, Persistence, Adaptability). All of these are relevant across disciplines and professions.

Gentem Indonesia Lifelong Learning (GILL) Group's mission is to cultivate lifelong learning from an early age in order to increase the competitiveness of Indonesians. GILL delivers premium, efficacious learning outcomes through exclusive partnerships with world-leading content providers and is heavily technology-enabled under separately branded businesses - Wall Street English, Genstarkids, and INDIES (Independent International Education Solutions).

GILL Group was established with the acquisition of the Wall Street English Indonesia business in 2016 and now has over 5,000 active members learning online and in-center across its 11 locations. Genstarkids was launched in October 2025 with the first studio in Bintaro and the second in Cikarang. INDIES was soft-launched in June 2024.

GILL also provides IELTS test prep courses as well as business english courses (professional skills) to both retail and corporate customers. Our corporate customers include blue-chip multinational companies as well as large local conglomerates.

title: Coal Quality Control
description_html:
Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure safe, efficient, and on-time execution of coal loading operations in compliance with K3LH standards.
  • Manage end-to-end shipment activities from jetty to mother vessel, including real-time coordination and issue resolution.
  • Control and monitor vessel line-up, barge schedules, and delivery flow to avoid delays and disruptions.
  • Deliver accurate and timely operational reports (loading progress, vessel schedule, weather updates, and shipping documents).
  • Coordinate effectively with agents, miners, surveyors, shippers, buyers, and vessel crew.
  • Oversee coal sampling and surveyor processes until final draft report issuance.
  • Validate and maintain accuracy of coal quality data and operational records (CO/SOB).
  • Ensure completeness and accuracy of all onboard documentation throughout loading activities.
  • Proactively identify and resolve operational issues to maintain smooth execution.
qualifications_html:
Qualifications

  • Minimum education of D3/S1 in Mining, Geology, or related fields.
  • Domiciled in Palembang, South Sumatra.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in coal mining, coal trading, port or shipping operations (must have exposure to vessel & barge operations).
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end coal shipment process (jetty to mother vessel), including loading, sampling, and surveyor reporting.
  • Good knowledge and experience in handling vessel line-up, barge scheduling, and real-time operational coordination.
  • Experienced in working closely with agents, surveyors, miners, shippers, and vessel crew.
  • Able to monitor operations on-site and onboard vessel when required.
  • Detail-oriented with strong ability to handle reporting, data reconciliation (CO/SOB), and documentation.
  • Good communication skills and able to work in a fast paced environment.
  • Able to handle operational pressure and resolve issues quickly on the ground.

Your new role is to effectively pass the training within the given timeframe and be able to provide outstanding bookkeeping services to help our clients manage their financial affairs.

Purpose

As a Bookkeeper (Level 1), you will:

  • Record financial transactions through our clients’ bookkeeping systems
  • Assist the supervisors or managers in producing financial reports
  • Process financial documents as needed by the clients.

As a Bookkeeper, your daily tasks may include:

  • Record financial transactions and complete the posting process to Xero and other cloud-based bookkeeping systems

  • Process purchase and sales invoices
  • Verify that invoices and transactions comply with Purchase Orders

  • Reconcile bank transactions, general ledger accounts, and other accounts

  • Complete year-end GST reconciliation with the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) lodgement documentation
  • Prepare and lodge Business (BAS) and Instalment Activity Statements (IAS) to the ATO
  • Process payroll, including payroll file payment and bank uploads
  • Process expense claims and reimbursements
  • Reconcile payroll and superannuation accounts
  • Assist with the month-end accounting process, including Payroll and Accounts Payable journals
  • Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable

  • Contribute to team effort by accomplishing other tasks as requested by the client and/or management.

description_html:
As a Financial Accountant, you shall be reporting to the Finance Manager, where you will play a key role within a small, collaborative finance team, to:

  • Supervise a small team in delivering day-to-day accounting functions, ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of financial information across the group, including profit centre reporting and management within Xero
  • Maintain delegation of authority and ensure compliance.
  • Enter intercompany transactions and reconciliations.

  • Coordinate weekly supplier payment runs.
  • Oversee payroll activities, coordinate weekly, fortnightly and monthly payroll payments.
  • Be responsible for other employee-related obligations, including supporting onboarding, payroll tax, superannuation and PAYG-W.
  • Complete end of month accounting processes, including ledger maintenance (and profit centre accounting), balance sheet reconciliations and journal adjustments for accruals.
  • Close the ledger by 5 working days, monthly.
  • Assist with the short-term monitoring of cash position and contribute to forward-looking cash planning.
  • Prepare and distribute the weekly dashboard to the management team and board
  • Be responsible for drafting activity statements for lodging with ATO (BAS/IAS/PAYG).
  • Work closely with the Finance Manager to identify and implement process improvement initiatives.
  • Contribute to team effort by accomplishing other tasks as requested by the client and/or management.
  • Perform other tasks as required by the client and the management

Clear is looking for a Financial Accountant to join our specialist team of accountants and bookkeepers working for Australian clients from a range of industries.

Role and Opportunity

Your role is to oversee and coordinate the group’s financial and administrative functions, ensuring proactive management, accuracy, timeliness, and operational efficiency. This position plays a key role in supporting the business with reliable financial insights for informed decision-making, while ensuring that all regulatory and compliance obligations are consistently met.

This is a hands-on role, where you are expected to perform the listed tasks to efficiently supervise a full-time bookkeeper and site-based administrative staff who assist with processing customer and supplier invoices, payroll, and selected month-end tasks.
qualifications_html:

title: Payroll Officers | Remote Work For Pooling
description_html:
Are you ready to play a vital role in supporting Australia’s agricultural workforce? Clear Admin People is on the hunt for smart, newly graduates aiming to become Payroll Officers. The ideal candidate must be highly skilled in using MS Excel & thrives in a dynamic environment that shares a strong passion for precision.


Role and Opportunity

As a Payroll Officer, you will "work from home" to support our client’s payroll team by delivering flawless payroll and timesheet processing in a timely manner for their various clients in the agriculture industry. Backed with more than 30 years of experience in the industry, our client is committed to providing the farmers with greater labour certainty and increased efficiency. They demand excellence and so do we.

Purpose

As a "remote" Payroll Officer, you will:

  • Process timesheets and payments to staff and clients within the business’s temporary workforce with absolute precision.
  • Take full responsibility for the timely preparation of salaries and payments – no mistakes, no excuses.
  • Proactively show initiative but never lose sight of the overall business objective.
  • As a Payroll Officer, your daily tasks may include:
  • Prepare weekly payroll with unyielding accuracy, on time, and in strict compliance with the relevant industrial instrument.
  • Ensure all timesheets, payroll changes, records, and other essential documents are submitted before the payroll run deadline – no exceptions.
  • Enter data with exacting accuracy for the continuous maintenance of payroll data within the system, including processing new starters or updating existing employee records.
  • Deliver electronic pay slips promptly to temporary and casual employees without delay.
  • Keep electronic filing systems meticulously organized for secure data retention.
  • Address payroll inquiries with impeccable customer service, providing accurate and timely responses verbally or in writing as required.
  • Reconcile and report on financial data related to payroll with rigorous attention to detail.
  • Request and manage payroll for special and late runs without fail.
  • Assists with the admin tasks to ensure updated records and requested reports are completed on time.
  • Perform other tasks as required by the client or management.
qualifications_html:
• Highly proficient in using Microsoft Excel & commonly-used MS Office apps (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Word, OneDrive)
  • With a proven inherent love for working with numbers
  • Comprehensive English communication skills (both verbal & written)
  • Exposure to payroll processing or any accounting-related task is an advantage
  • Working knowledge or experience in using any payroll systems, such as M.Y.O.B., Astute, or Xero), is a plus
  • Open to Fresh Graduates (Accounting/Finance or related courses)

Required Attributes

  • You are an expert in using MS Excel with relentless attention to detail.
  • Being technologically adept, you can quickly learn new systems & software.
  • You are a multi-tasker who consistently meet strict deadlines & performs with minimal supervision while producing outstanding results.
  • You respect confidentiality and the sensitivity of every information you handle.
  • You are flexible & professional to perform other tasks as required by the client or management.
  • You have a "fit-to-work" status upon completion of the pre-employment medical exam that includes the drug test and you possess a valid NBI Clearance.
